title: Doctor name printed as "Dr. Dr. …" in conflict errors and audit entries
foundIn: System testing (UI walkthrough of booking a taken slot)
steps: Book an appointment in a slot that is already taken for Dr. Arjun Sharma.
expected: Message: "Dr. Arjun Sharma already has an appointment at …"
actual: Message: "Dr. Dr. Arjun Sharma already has an appointment at …" (same in audit log summaries).
rootCause: Service prefixed "Dr." to full_name, which already contains the title.
fix: Removed the extra prefix in appointmentService and queueService.

title: Payment receipt shows the invoice's current balance instead of the balance after that payment
foundIn: System testing (reprinting the first receipt of an invoice paid in two instalments)
steps: Pay ₹100 of an ₹900 invoice, then pay the remaining ₹800, then print the first receipt.
expected: First receipt shows balance after payment ₹800.00.
actual: First receipt shows balance ₹0.00 (uses the invoice's latest paid amount).
rootCause: BillingService.receipt() computed total − invoice.paid_amount.
fix: Balance is now total − SUM(payments with id ≤ this payment).

title: Invoice list ordered by internal id rather than invoice date
foundIn: System testing (Billing → Invoices tab)
steps: Open Billing → Invoices after loading demo data.
actual: Older invoices created later in the seed appeared first.
rootCause: ORDER BY i.id DESC.
fix: ORDER BY i.created_at DESC, i.id DESC.

title: Clicking a form label toggles the first payment-method / working-day button
foundIn: System testing (Record payment dialog)
steps: Open Record payment, select UPI, then click on the "Payment method" label text.
actual: Selection jumps to CASH because the buttons were nested inside a <label> element.
rootCause: Button group wrapped by the shared Field component, which renders a <label>.
fix: Button groups use a plain caption and role=radio / aria-pressed buttons.

title: Transferring a patient on the day of admission bills two minimum bed-days
foundIn: System testing (admit → transfer after a few minutes → request discharge)
steps: Admit to General Ward A (₹1,500/day), transfer to General Ward B after 10 minutes, request discharge 5 hours later.
actual: 2 bed-days charged (₹3,000): each bed stay applied its own 1-day minimum.
rootCause: bedCharges() applied max(1, ceil(h/24)) per stay instead of per admission.
fix: Admission is billed max(1, ceil(totalHours/24)) days, shared across stays by largest-remainder allocation; zero-day stays are not charged.

title: Demo data gives one patient two tokens with the same doctor on the same day
foundIn: System testing (Queue board shows P00017 with tokens #04 and #05)
steps: Load demo data, open Dr. Sharma's queue board.
expected: A patient appears at most once per doctor per day.
actual: The same patient appeared twice in the queue.
rootCause: Seeder only prevented identical time slots, not repeat visits to the same doctor.
fix: Seeder tracks patient + doctor + date.

title: Laboratory status counters ignore the doctor's "My orders" filter
foundIn: System testing (doctor view of Laboratory page)
steps: Log in as a doctor, open Laboratory, keep "My orders" selected.
expected: Tab counts reflect only the doctor's orders.
actual: Tab counts showed hospital-wide totals.
rootCause: /lab/stats had no doctor filter.
fix: /lab/stats accepts doctorId; page passes it when "My orders" is selected.

title: Patient picker in the Admit dialog does not flag patients who are already admitted
foundIn: System testing (admit dialog)
steps: Open Admit patient and search for a patient who is currently admitted.
expected: Picker marks the patient as already admitted.
actual: Patient can be selected; the server then correctly rejects the admission with "already admitted" (FR-39 is still enforced).
rootCause: Picker does not query active admissions (usability enhancement).
fix: Deferred to next release – business rule is enforced server-side and covered by IT-IPD-02.

title: Impossible calendar dates (e.g. 30 February) are accepted
foundIn: Robustness / edge-case testing (boundary and invalid-input probes against the API)
steps: Book an appointment on 2027-02-30; register a patient with DOB 1990-02-30; restock with expiry 2027-02-31.
actual: Accepted (201/200); JavaScript rolled the date over to March and the invalid value was stored.
rootCause: Date fields were validated only by the YYYY-MM-DD regular expression.
fix: isRealDate() added to the domain layer and used by every date validator.

title: Malformed date filters cause an internal server error
foundIn: Robustness / edge-case testing (boundary and invalid-input probes against the API)
steps: GET /api/reports/summary?from=abc, /api/billing/invoices?from=abc, /api/audit?from=2026-99-99.
actual: HTTP 500 Internal server error (RangeError: Invalid time value).
rootCause: new Date('abcT00:00').toISOString() throws; query dates were not validated.
fix: optionalDate() validator applied to all date query parameters.

title: Report period is not validated (from after to, multi-year ranges)
foundIn: Robustness / edge-case testing (boundary and invalid-input probes against the API)
steps: GET /api/reports/summary?from=2026-10-30&to=2026-10-01.
actual: HTTP 200 with an empty or very large report.
rootCause: No ordering or range checks.
fix: Reject from > to and ranges longer than 366 days; the UI also keeps from ≤ to.

title: Non-text and over-long patient fields are stored
foundIn: Robustness / edge-case testing (boundary and invalid-input probes against the API)
steps: Register a patient with first_name ["a"] or a 5,000-character name.
actual: HTTP 201 – the array/huge string was stored.
rootCause: No type or length checks on patient fields.
fix: Type checks and maximum lengths (names 60, email 120, address/allergies 300).

title: Mobile numbers typed with +91, spaces or a leading 0 are rejected
foundIn: Robustness / edge-case testing (boundary and invalid-input probes against the API)
steps: Register a patient with phone "+91 98765 43210".
actual: HTTP 400 "Enter a valid 10-digit mobile number".
rootCause: Strict 10-digit regular expression without normalisation.
fix: normalizePhone() on server and client (spaces, dashes, brackets, +91/91/0 prefixes).

title: Search terms containing % or _ match every record
foundIn: Robustness / edge-case testing (boundary and invalid-input probes against the API)
steps: GET /api/patients?q=%
actual: All patients returned.
rootCause: User input inserted into LIKE patterns without escaping wildcards.
fix: likeTerm() escapes % and _ (LIKE … ESCAPE '\').

title: Negative limit returns every row
foundIn: Robustness / edge-case testing (boundary and invalid-input probes against the API)
steps: GET /api/appointments?limit=-1
actual: All rows (SQLite treats a negative LIMIT as unlimited); NaN offsets passed through.
rootCause: Math.min(Number(limit) || default, max) keeps negative values.
fix: clampInt() clamps limit/offset into a valid range.

title: Free-text reasons accept numbers and unlimited length
foundIn: Robustness / edge-case testing (boundary and invalid-input probes against the API)
steps: Admit a patient with reason 42 or a 2,000-character reason.
actual: Generic error for a number; very long text accepted.
rootCause: nonEmpty() validator had no type message or maximum length.
fix: nonEmpty(label, max) with type and length checks; discharge summary ≤ 5,000 characters.

title: No-show can be recorded before the appointment time
foundIn: Robustness / edge-case testing (boundary and invalid-input probes against the API)
steps: At 10:00, mark today's 15:00 appointment as no-show.
expected: HTTP 400 – the appointment has not started yet.
actual: HTTP 200, status NO_SHOW.
rootCause: Only future dates were checked, not the time on the current day.
fix: For today's appointments the start time must have passed.

title: Appointments can be booked with a deactivated doctor
foundIn: Robustness / edge-case testing (boundary and invalid-input probes against the API)
steps: Administrator deactivates a doctor's account; receptionist books that doctor.
actual: HTTP 201 – booking created.
rootCause: Doctor's user account status not checked when booking.
fix: assertBookable() rejects inactive doctors (booking and rescheduling).

title: A doctor can order tests on another doctor's consultation; duplicate tests are ordered twice
foundIn: Robustness / edge-case testing (boundary and invalid-input probes against the API)
steps: Dr. Banerjee orders FBS on Dr. Sharma's open consultation; order test_ids [FBS, FBS].
expected: HTTP 403; a duplicate test is ordered once.
actual: HTTP 201; two identical orders and two charges.
rootCause: No ownership check and no de-duplication of test ids.
fix: Ownership check (403), de-duplication, and 409 DUPLICATE_LAB_ORDER if the same test is still pending for the visit.

title: The same medicine can appear twice in one prescription
foundIn: Robustness / edge-case testing (boundary and invalid-input probes against the API)
steps: Save a prescription with two Paracetamol lines.
expected: HTTP 400 "Each medicine can appear only once".
actual: Accepted; dispensing and billing showed duplicate lines.
rootCause: No duplicate check on prescription items.
fix: Duplicate medicines rejected; maximum 30 items.

title: A zero-value invoice stays UNPAID and cannot be settled
foundIn: Robustness / edge-case testing (boundary and invalid-input probes against the API)
steps: Doctor with a ₹0 (free camp) fee completes a visit; billing generates the invoice.
actual: Status UNPAID; a ₹0 payment is rejected, so the invoice could never be closed and blocked discharge.
rootCause: Status was always initialised to UNPAID.
fix: Invoices with total 0 are created as PAID.

title: Admission / invoice / receipt numbers can collide with existing numbers
foundIn: Robustness / edge-case testing (boundary and invalid-input probes against the API)
steps: With demo data containing ADM-20261021-019, admit about 18 patients on the same day.
actual: The 18th admission of the day would generate an existing number and fail with a database constraint error.
rootCause: Sequence computed as COUNT(*)+1 for the day, which is wrong when numbers have gaps or come from imported data.
fix: nextSequence() uses the highest existing suffix + 1 for admissions, invoices and receipts; seed numbers admissions per day.

title: Lab worklist date filter uses the UTC day instead of the local day
foundIn: Code review during robustness testing
steps: Order a test at 01:00 IST on 22-Oct; filter the worklist by 2026-10-22.
actual: Listed under 21-Oct (UTC date of the timestamp).
rootCause: substr(created_at, 1, 10) compares the UTC date part of an ISO timestamp.
fix: Filter uses the local day converted to a UTC time range.

title: Some database constraint errors are reported as HTTP 500
foundIn: Code review during robustness testing
steps: Trigger a NOT NULL / trigger constraint error through an unexpected path.
actual: HTTP 500 Internal server error.
rootCause: Error handler mapped only three SQLite constraint codes.
fix: Every SQLITE_CONSTRAINT* code maps to HTTP 409.
verifiedBy: Code review re-test (no API path triggers it)

title: Pages scroll sideways on phones
foundIn: Robustness / edge-case testing of the UI (role × page crawl at 1440 px and 390 px, bad deep links)
steps: Open /, /queue (doctor), /admissions/1, /billing/invoices/1 or /reports at 390 px width.
expected: Page fits the screen; wide tables scroll inside their card.
actual: Page became 444–641 px wide (horizontal page scroll).
rootCause: Cards inside CSS grid columns kept min-width:auto, so wide tables stretched the column.
fix: Cards get min-width 0 so tables scroll inside the card.

title: Long unbroken text overflows the patient header
foundIn: Robustness / edge-case testing of the UI (role × page crawl at 1440 px and 390 px, bad deep links)
steps: Register a patient with a 250-character unbroken address; open the record at 390 px.
actual: Page became 1,648 px wide.
rootCause: Inline elements without word wrapping or min-width.
fix: Name, e-mail and address wrap anywhere.

title: Create-user dialog keeps the previous user's data, including the password
foundIn: Code review of dialogs during robustness testing
steps: Create a user, then open “Create user” again.
actual: Previous username, name and password still filled in.
rootCause: Form state initialised only when the component first mounted.
fix: Form resets each time the dialog opens (also Add department).

title: Missing or forbidden records show a generic “Could not load data – Retry” message
foundIn: Robustness / edge-case testing of the UI (role × page crawl at 1440 px and 390 px, bad deep links)
steps: Open /patients/99999 or /admissions/abc.
expected: “Record not found” (or “Access denied”) with a way back.
actual: Generic error with a Retry button that cannot help.
rootCause: ErrorState treated every error the same.
fix: 404 → “Record not found”, 403 → “Access denied”, both with “Go back”.

title: Prescription and medicine forms accept fractional or absurd numbers
foundIn: Robustness / edge-case testing of the UI (role × page crawl at 1440 px and 390 px, bad deep links)
steps: Enter quantity 2.5, duration 0.5 days, price "abc" or reorder level −3.
actual: Client checks passed; the server rejected the request with a less readable error.
rootCause: Checks only tested ≥ 1 / ≥ 0 (NaN comparisons are false).
fix: Whole-number and finiteness checks with sensible maxima.

title: Session expiry and server outages show unclear messages
foundIn: Robustness / edge-case testing of the UI (role × page crawl at 1440 px and 390 px, bad deep links)
steps: Revoke a session token, then navigate; or stop the API server.
expected: Login page explains that the session ended; outage shows a readable message.
actual: Silent redirect; raw “Unexpected token <” / “Failed to fetch”.
rootCause: API client did not map network or non-JSON failures.
fix: Readable network/server messages; “Your session has ended” notice after involuntary logout.

title: Disabled “Sign in” button has low contrast
foundIn: Robustness / edge-case testing of the UI (role × page crawl at 1440 px and 390 px, bad deep links)
steps: Open the login page with empty fields.
expected: Normal-contrast button; empty fields reported on submit.
actual: Button faded (60% opacity) until both fields were filled.
rootCause: Disabled state used for input validation.
fix: Button always enabled; submit validates the fields.

title: React Router future-flag warnings on every page in development mode
foundIn: Robustness / edge-case testing of the UI (role × page crawl at 1440 px and 390 px, bad deep links)
steps: npm run dev; open any page and check the console.
actual: Two warnings per navigation.
rootCause: Router v7 behaviour flags not opted into.
fix: Enabled v7_startTransition and v7_relativeSplatPath.

title: Bed-stay note and lab units display incorrectly
foundIn: Robustness / edge-case testing of the UI (role × page crawl at 1440 px and 390 px, bad deep links)
steps: Open an admission; open the lab result form for a numeric test.
expected: Bed note describes the per-admission bed-day rule; units shown as “mg/dL”.
actual: Bed note still said “minimum 1 day” per stay (outdated after DEF-05); unit shown as “MG/DL”.
rootCause: Text not updated after DEF-05; unit placed inside an uppercase label style.
fix: Updated text; units rendered in their real case.
